An overview of this role

As a Senior Deal Desk Analyst, you'll be a key partner to GitLab's Asia-Pacific and Japan (APJ) Sales and Revenue teams, shaping how we structure, quote, and book deals that support our growth. You'll sit at the center of the quote-to-cash process and serve as the subject matter expert for sales-assisted quotes in Salesforce. You'll ensure deal intent is accurately captured in quotes, order forms, and bookings, and help resolve issues before they require systems or information technology support.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, using your knowledge of deal structures, approvals, and contract language to guide deals toward compliant, scalable solutions that help close business. You'll work daily with Salesforce and Zuora Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), or similar tools, to review pricing and products, validate order forms, and troubleshoot issues. When needed, you'll complete manual checks using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar spreadsheet tools.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support accurate annual recurring revenue (ARR) reporting, smooth collections, and data integrity across the revenue lifecycle. In this fully remote, fast-paced environment, you'll consistently meet response service-level agreements, improve quote quality and booking accuracy, and strengthen the trusted relationship between Deal Desk and Sales as GitLab continues to expand its AI-powered DevSecOps platform.

What you'll do

  • Act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource on deal structure, quoting, order form creation, and contract options that support deal closure.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Sales questions related to deal structure, opportunity booking, subscription management, and license delivery.
  • Navigate complex deal cycles alongside Sales and partner with key internal stakeholders to fulfill deal requirements.
  • Own the quote review process, including validating Salesforce opportunities, quotes, and order forms to ensure accurate deal structures, metrics, and downstream bookings.
  • Review sales-assisted contracts from Salesforce for accuracy and intent, confirming that commercial terms, including price locks and billing terms, are correctly reflected and comply with revenue recognition requirements and internal policies.
  • Partner with Sales to interpret deal intent, advise on options within GitLab's pricing and packaging framework, and troubleshoot quoting issues in Salesforce, Zuora CPQ, or related tools before engaging technical teams.
  • Support the end-to-end quote-to-cash process by working with Billing, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Accounting, Ecosystem, and other partners to resolve subscription, invoicing, and collection issues.
  • Analyze deal and quoting data to identify recurring issues, recommend process or configuration improvements, and create clear guidance that reduces errors and rework.
  • Participate in regional sales forecast calls, quarterly business reviews, and end-of-quarter standups, providing clear updates on deal status, risks, and required actions.
  • Work hours aligned with the GMT+10 time zone.

What you'll bring

  • Experience supporting quoting, pricing, opportunity booking, subscription management, and bookings within Deal Desk, billing operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a similar quote-to-cash function.
  • The ability to provide discounting and pricing guidance, with an understanding of standalone selling price and profitability ranges.
  • Strong CPQ skills and technical knowledge, ideally including experience with Zuora or a similar tool, and the ability to understand how calculations and charges are generated across products and pricing models. Experience with consumption-based structures is a plus.
  • Practical Salesforce experience, including creating and reviewing quotes, managing opportunities, and troubleshooting data or process issues to support accurate booking metrics.
  • The ability to interpret commercial contracts and understand how legal and commercial terms, including price locks and term commitments, affect deal structure, pricing, bookings, and approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy across quotes, order forms, and bookings, including the ability to validate or recreate scenarios using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the initiative to identify the root causes of quote-to-cash issues and partner with systems and cross-functional teams to prevent recurring errors.
  • An understanding of revenue recognition concepts in a software-as-a-service environment and experience partnering with Finance, Billing, Accounts Receivable, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support compliant, timely bookings and collections.
  • Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to advise and build trust with Sales teams in a highly collaborative, remote environment.
  • Experience with enterprise deal structures and legal terms that may affect contract structure.
  • The ability to prioritize your workload in line with Sales expectations and changing business needs.

About the team

Our Deal Desk team is responsible for the processes that power GitLab's end-to-end sales bookings, from quoting and deal structuring through contract review, booking, and handoff to billing and collections. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Accounts Receivable to support accurate, timely, and compliant bookings in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

You'll join a highly tenured, trusted group of Analysts and Strategists who serve as the first line of support for quotes in Salesforce, review sales-assisted contracts, and help troubleshoot quote-to-cash issues before they reach our systems teams. Together, we focus on getting the details right, maintaining strong partnerships with our Sales teams, and making it easier for customers to buy and expand with GitLab.

Overview

Unison’s products power the business of government to work smoother and smarter, making critical federal processes and acquisitions simpler and more effective. Unison Software Solutions, a leading provider for procurement solutions to the federal marketplace, is seeking a Consultant. Unison consultants work directly with clients to understand key elements of client business processes and then work to implement and operate Unison software products and service offerings by performing key tasks. Consultants thrive on their personal and direct contributions that help our clients achieve substantial benefits from our suite of software products.

In support of Unison's PRISM, Unison is seeking an experienced Testing Lead to support the maintenance and modernization of a department-level federal agency. This role will own and drive testing activities across system upgrades, patches, new releases, fixes, and enhancements. The Test Lead will combine hands-on testing expertise with leadership, ensuring that system changes are thoroughly planned, executed, validated, and ready for release.

The successful candidate will establish the overall testing approach, lead both planning and execution, oversee supporting QA resources, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams, business stakeholders, and federal customer leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall testing and release-validation strategy for upgrades, patches, fixes, new releases, and system enhancements.
  • Develop the testing approach and review and approve test plans, test cases, scripts, expected results, and entry and exit criteria.
  • Lead and execute System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), upgrade testing, regression testing, and other testing activities as required.
  • Develop, write, maintain, and execute test plans and test cases based on business requirements, technical designs, system specifications, and user workflows.
  • Validate test results and provide clear recommendations regarding system and release readiness.
  • Manage the submission, prioritization, tracking, retesting, and resolution of defects through closure.
  • Coordinate with developers, requirements analysts, business analysts, designers, and customer stakeholders to verify issues and confirm resolutions.
  • Oversee and coordinate the responsibilities and activities of the QA Test Support resource.
  • Review requirements, design documentation, user documentation, release notes, and project specifications for completeness, accuracy, and testability.
  • Identify testing risks, dependencies, coverage gaps, and readiness concerns, and communicate them clearly to project leadership.
  • Provide business-process optimization recommendations based on testing results, observed system behavior, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Develop clear testing status reports, defect summaries, readiness assessments, and recommendations for project and customer leadership.
  • Support testing schedules, resource planning, and coordination across multiple workstreams.
  • Help establish and maintain an automated regression testing suite using Selenium WebDriver.
  • Identify high-value regression scenarios appropriate for automation and coordinate their conversion into reusable automated test scripts.
  • Integrate automated regression testing into upgrade, patch, release, and enhancement validation activities.
  • Review automated test results, investigate failures, and determine whether issues are caused by defects, test data, environment conditions, or script maintenance needs.
  • Build strong working relationships with federal customer stakeholders and serve as a trusted advisor on testing quality, risk, and release readiness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience testing integrated, web-based software applications.
  • Demonstrated experience leading testing for upgrades, patches, fixes, releases, and system enhancements.
  • Experience developing and executing testing strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and defect validation.
  • Experience using defect-tracking, test-management, or configuration-management processes and tools.
  • Ability to review and interpret business requirements, technical designs, workflows, user documentation, and system specifications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and logical process-thinking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain testing risks, defects, results, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across project, technical, business, and customer teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required federal Public Trust determination.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal-government software implementations or modernization initiatives in a consulting capacity.
  • Knowledge of the federal acquisition or procurement process.
  • Experience with Unison’s PRISM.
  • Experience testing acquisition, financial-management, enterprise-resource-planning, or other complex business applications.
  • Experience working across multiple releases, patches, integrations, or concurrent testing workstreams.
  • Experience using Selenium WebDriver to create, execute, and maintain automated regression tests.
  • Experience designing or expanding an automated regression framework, including identifying appropriate test cases for automation.

Reports to: Executive Director
Location: Remote (Candidate may be located in Nashville or Memphis)
WHO WE ARE
Fueled by passion and urgency, the National Kidney Foundation is a lifeline for all people affected by kidney disease. As pioneers of scientific research and innovation, NKF focuses on the whole patient through the lens of kidney health. Relentless in our work, we enhance lives through action, education, and accelerating change.

NKF’s Mission is what we do, our Values are how we do it.

WHO YOU ARE
You are a dynamic and results- driven Development Director well versed in leading fundraising initiatives for similar sized nonprofit organizations. You are skilled at building and executing comprehensive development strategies and serving as an ambassador for influential organizations. You have a proven success record working with both authority and influence to manage and steward a portfolio of corporate and individual relationships to drive growth and achieve defined revenue goals.

Come join us as a Development Director with responsibility for the TN area (Nashville, Memphis and Knoxville markets) with specific focus on Walk and Distinguished Events, including Social and Golf events. This position is a front-line fundraiser and ambassador for the National Kidney Foundation and will speak knowledgeably and persuasively about the mission of the organization and the variety of ways to engage.
The Development Director will raise annual funds by recruiting and managing executive leadership volunteers and committees, raising awareness, establishing and securing corporate partnerships and implementing fundraising and mission-related events to achieve revenue goals. A successful candidate will manage and steward a diverse portfolio of corporate, and individual, and foundation relationships and drive significant revenue growth to achieve our mission objectives.
The ideal candidate must have proven success in front-line fundraising and relationship management. Exceptional organizational, written, and verbal communication skills are necessary for this position. Must have ability to multitask, meet deadlines, and achieve results in a collaborative team environment.

  • Manage a fundraising portfolio for (local) Kidney Walks, Distinguished Social/Special Events, including the Memphis Social and Golf Classic events
  • Creating and executing fundraising strategies, work to grow additional revenue for the NKF
  • Serve as a member of the TN team influencing and driving relationships and best practices to accomplish market and region financial goals
  • Accountable to develop and steward a portfolio of relationships to provide funding for our mission (sponsorship, campaigns, event teams, grants, donations, and other partnerships)
  • Ensure accurate revenue projections and provide financial analysis
  • Oversee stewardship activities; ensure a high-touch response to partners and donors
  • Work with high level volunteers, leadership committees to provide local leadership, resources, and partnerships
  • Drive donor centric corporate, individual and foundation partnerships to support financial goals of market events, programs and prioritized initiatives

  • Demonstrate integrity, collaboration and stewardship
  • Other duties as assigned

  • 7+ years demonstrated leadership with focus on peer-to-peer fundraising, recruitment and management of volunteers, relationship-building, networking, budget management, and volunteer mobilization.
  • Proven track record of multi-functional fundraising experience: special events, multiple walk events, corporate engagement and campaigns.
  • Outcome driven with ability to respond to changing circumstances and priorities.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • NKF Colorado and New Mexico offers a flexible hybrid work environment
  • Work/life Integration: Enjoy plenty of vacation time, sick leave, and holidays so you can recharge, regroup or reflect—and come back ready to tackle anything
  • Support for Your Health: We've got your back with top-notch medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your loved ones
  • Peace of Mind: Rest easy knowing you're covered with life insurance and a 403(b) plan with matching company contributions to secure your future
  • Creative savings: Take advantage of flexible spending accounts to save on eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses
  • Easy Commuting: Reduce your stress with our commuter benefits program for transit and parking expenses
  • Support When You Need It: Access confidential counseling, support services, and resources through our Employee Assistance Program
  • A Chance to Spread the Word: Share the love and earn rewards by referring awesome folks to join our team
  • A Big Tent: We're all about creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and heard
  • Mission-Fueled Culture: Join a team that's passionate about making a difference and guided by values like integrity, compassion, and innovation

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

At the National Kidney Foundation, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity apply to both our workforce and the communities we serve as they relate to kidney health and kidney disease prevention. It is the policy of NKF to provide equality of employment opportunity regardless of race, creed, color, qualified handicap or disability, national origin, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, age, gender, political affiliation or veteran status, or any other factor or reason prohibited by relevant local, state, and federal fair employment laws.

Must have unimpeachable integrity and trustworthiness while possessing a high degree of tact, discretion, and professionalism. Verbal and written communication skills will be used daily. While remote candidates will be considered, preference will be given to candidates located near a Guidehouse office in one of the following markets: Arlington, VA; Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; and Boulder, CO.

  • Develop and support batch and streaming data workflows, including ingestion, transformation, validation, and publishing of curated data products.

  • Write, optimize, and maintain Python, PySpark, and SQL code for data processing, orchestration, and performance tuning.

  • Work with large-scale datasets using Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and cloud storage services.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, performance issues, data quality issues, and workflow bottlenecks.

Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. jobs.excerpt: About Solar Provider GroupSolar Provider Group (SPG) is a global solar developer with offices in the United States, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands and active projects across North America and Europe.
jobs.description:
About Solar Provider Group

Solar Provider Group (SPG) is a global solar developer with offices in the United States, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands and active projects across North America and Europe. This role is part of the Company’s North American team, which is focused primarily on the development of solar and BESS projects in the United States and Canada, with most current activity in the United States. We identify, secure, and advance high-quality sites through the full development cycle, from early-stage land acquisition to construction readiness. Our team combines technical expertise, financial insight, and strong local relationships to deliver projects that accelerate the clean-energy transition and create lasting value for landowners and communities.

The Role

We are seeking a motivated, relationship-driven, and results-oriented Land Partnerships Specialist to generate and advance land opportunities across the Company’s target markets. This role is responsible for landowner outreach, opportunity qualification, site pursuit, and lease advancement, with the goal of helping move prospects from first contact to executed site control.

This is an outreach-focused role for someone who is comfortable prospecting, building trust quickly, managing a pipeline, and conducting ordinary-course negotiations based on the Company’s internal criteria, with a heavy focus on email marketing and cold-calling. It is well suited to someone who is motivated, persuasive, organized, eager to learn, and comfortable working independently in a phone- and email-driven role, with in-person follow-up where needed. Strong candidates may come from land acquisition, inside or outside sales, business development, right-of-way, real estate, agriculture, or other relationship-driven roles.

This position is fully remote for candidates based in the United States. You’ll work from home while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Remote work arrangements are subject to change with appropriate notice based on company needs. Frequent travel across U.S. states to visit project sites and engage with local communities should be expected.

Duties & Responsibilities

Landowner Outreach and Deal Advancement

  • Conduct proactive outreach to landowners primarily through cold calls and email marketing, with some in-person visits, referrals, local events, and other relationship-driven channels within the Company’s target markets.
  • Build trust with landowners to advance prospects from initial contact through active pursuit and toward executed site control.
  • Conduct ordinary-course negotiations with landowners on leases, easements, options, and related site-control arrangements within the Company’s templates and criteria.
  • Escalate complex commercial, legal, title, or reputational issues to the Director of Real Estate and/or General Counsel, as needed.
  • Present the Company’s value proposition clearly and professionally, including the general solar and BESS development process, expected timelines, and the benefits of working with the Company.

Opportunity Qualification and Field Coordination

  • Gather and communicate key site and landowner information needed to assess opportunity quality and move prospects forward.
  • Assess property quality in the field or remotely in coordination with internal teams, including development and interconnection.
  • Work independently to source and pursue opportunities while operating within the Company’s values, thresholds, and requirements.
  • Work from prospect lists and contribute additional opportunities through self-generated outreach and local relationship-building.
  • Share insights, landowner feedback, and observations that may improve outreach strategy, messaging, and conversion.

Pipeline Discipline and Execution

  • Maintain accurate and timely records in the Company’s CRM, including outreach activity, notes, next steps, and opportunity status.
  • Use company systems and tools with reasonable discipline and consistency to support visibility, coordination, and follow-through.
  • Work closely with the Land Acquisition Strategy Manager and Land Acquisition Coordinator to ensure opportunities are tracked, organized, and advanced efficiently.

Travel

  • Travel extensively within assigned regions, with travel expected to represent up to 25% of the month.
  • Maintain flexibility for occasional evening or weekend meetings when needed to accommodate landowner schedules.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in outside sales, business development, land acquisition, right-of-way, real estate, agriculture, or another relationship-driven field role.
  • Proven ability to build trust quickly, generate opportunities, and move conversations toward action.
  • Strong communication and people skills, with the judgment and presence to engage credibly with landowners and local stakeholders.
  • Comfort conducting negotiations and advancing deals within defined commercial and legal guardrails.
  • Highly self-motivated and capable of working autonomously, while engaging the internal stakeholders effectively as needed.
  • Strong follow-up habits and comfort managing multiple active opportunities at once.
  • Comfortable and effective using CRM systems, mobile tools, and other technology to stay organized in the field. Experience with Monday.com or similar platforms is an asset.
  • Experience in solar, BESS, land acquisition, or rural landowner engagement is helpful but not required.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within assigned markets.

How to Apply

Qualified applicants are invited to apply via our BambooHR portal by May 15, 2026. We thank all candidates for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. No agency submissions, please.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

SPG is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that different backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our ability to make an impact. Every team member should feel valued, respected, and supported as part of our mission to expand renewable energy.

Accessibility: SPG provides accommodations throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable laws. To request an accommodation, please contact the Human Resources team.

Salary: Base salary of $55,000+, plus commission

Emergency Corporate Travel Consultant (After Hours/Weekends)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Corporate Travel Consultant who can handle urgent travel requests, provide timely assistance, and ensure our clients' needs are met, no matter the time of day, to be an integral part of our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team.

As one of our Emergency Corporate Travel Consultants, you will be providing exceptional service and ensuring smooth travel experiences for corporate clients including air, hotel, and ground transportation reservations via Sabre GDS during after-hours and unforeseen situations.

  • Demonstrating the ability to work efficiently and multitask while maintaining a professional and positive rapport with clients.
  • Ensuring compliance with service level agreements to deliver timely and efficient travel assistance.

  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations.

jobs.excerpt: Mission: Our engineering team is known for solving problems that others consider impossible.
jobs.description:
Mission:
Our engineering team is known for solving problems that others consider impossible. Now we need a Marketing Guru who can do the same—but in the field of growth.
This isn't about “promotion” or glossy magazines. This is marketing as an engineering discipline of opportunity: analysis, hypotheses, experiments, and strategies that open up new markets before anyone else knows they exist.
You will work directly with the founders and leading engineers, turning technical excellence into a market advantage. Your task is to create a system for attracting new customers from complex and non-obvious domains.

What needs to be done
- Define marketing strategy and performance standards at the company level.
- Conduct marketing as research and development: hypotheses → tests → results.
- Ensure a predictable flow of new inbound leads from target markets (US/Europe).
- Link marketing to revenue, integrate it into the sales and delivery cycle.
- Manage the full cycle of marketing functions (analytics, content, brand, digital).
- Take personal responsibility for results by creating a system rather than dependence on performers.

Key performance indicators
1. Creation of marketing assets
- Timely development of new marketing and commercial materials: landing pages, posts, advertising campaigns, presentations.
- Delivery time: up to 1 week from the moment the task is set.
- Quality: engagement and conversion above industry standards (conversion > 3%).
- Materials directly support the sales funnel and generate inbound demand.

2. Formation and verification of marketing hypotheses
- A continuous process of generating and testing hypotheses about the audience, positioning, and channels.
- Each hypothesis must be tested within 2 weeks with clear metrics (go/no-go).
- We implement an evidence-based marketing approach: we measure, test, and scale.

3. Return on marketing investment (ROMI)
- ROMI is no less than 10:1, with quarterly improvement in lead cost.
- Analytics are based on CV, UV, CPL, and ROI metrics.
- Budget optimization is achieved by prioritizing channels with maximum profitability.

4. Administrative and reporting discipline
- Transparency and manageability of the process through accurate reporting, documentation, and metrics.
- 100% compliance with internal standards for reporting, documentation, and deadlines.
- As the team scales, advanced performance and engagement metrics are added.

5. Brand recognition and awareness
- Builds and strengthens Gehtsoft brand awareness in target markets (the US and Western Europe).
- During the first 90 days, basic brand awareness metrics are established and growth is tracked.
- The goal is to steadily increase brand awareness among target audiences.

6. Marketing and sales synergy
- Works closely with the sales department to create a unified lead generation and conversion cycle.
- Joint responsibility for achieving revenue and funnel filling goals.

Indicators:
≥ 50 new MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads) per week,

conversion to meetings > 20%,

further stages of the funnel — above the industry benchmark.

Who we are looking for
- A strategist with an engineering mindset: hypothesis → experiment → result.
- A leader who can look for opportunities rather than excuses.
- Someone who sees patterns where others see noise.
- A specialist who can turn ideas into a system and a system into results.

Requirements
- Experience in B2B/B2C marketing, digital and content strategies.
- Case experience in the US and Western European markets.
- Ability to link marketing metrics to financial indicators.
- Team management and C-suite working skills.
- Ability to quickly immerse yourself in IT markets, technologies, and client industries.
- Financial and operational maturity: working with ROI, budget, and risks.

Why Gehtsoft
Gehtsoft USA is an engineering company founded in 1999, specializing in non-recurring custom development. Our clients are based in the US and Western Europe, mainly in the B2B and FinTech sectors.
We are not looking for marketers who will embellish presentations.
We are looking for researchers who will discover new areas of growth before others do.
If you see marketing as a discipline of finding patterns and creating value, and consider data to be the best source of inspiration, then welcome aboard.

jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:

The Manager, External Affairs, Asia Pacific supports the advancement of The Nature Conservancy’s public funding and external engagement priorities across the region. Reporting to the Director of External Affairs, Asia Pacific, this role plays a key regional function in contributing to the implementation of the One Conservancy Public Funding Strategy, with a strong emphasis on building and managing relationships with targeted public sector entities and securing public funding in support of TNC’s 2030 Goals. The Manager will engage with major public institutions, governments, multi-lateral agencies, NGOs, public officials, influential individuals, and TNC staff to support the positioning of TNC with public sector entities, as a leading organization for the design and delivery of conservation work in the Asia-Pacific region. The Manager also works with TNC’s global strategy teams, Science and Field Conservation staff, other External Affairs departments and with TNC’s Operating Units to further conservation goals, policies and strategy.

This role is a two‑year fixed‑term position with the possibility of extension, subject to work performance, business needs, and funding availability.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
The Manager contributes to TNC’s conservation impact by strengthening our strategic engagement with public sector entities, supporting the co-creation of projects, and enhancing internal capability to both locate and capture public funding for TNC and influence the nature and scope of public funding policy, relevant to achieving TNC’s 2030 goals. Key functions include:

Implementing the Public Funding Strategy

  • Support implementation of the One Conservancy Public Funding Strategy across Asia Pacific, including the achievement of Organisational Key Results related to the amount of public funding captured in a fiscal year and the anticipated value of the pipeline of public funded projects going into the next fiscal year.

  • Identify and assess public funding opportunities across Asia Pacific.

  • Support prioritization of public sector engagement to maximize funding outcomes and provide direct support to TNC Business Units to capture prioritised public funding through either selected competitive calls for proposals or through collaborative project formulation where projects are co-designed with targeted public donors.

  • Align regional actions with global strategy to drive coordinated engagement with priority public donors.

  • Facilitate co-creation of projects with governments, bilateral and multilateral donors.

  • Monitor and prepare reports and recommendations on public fundraising efforts to global and regional leadership.

Strengthening Public Sector Relationship Management

Under the direction of the nominated TNC Relationship Manager for a specific PSE, develop and strengthen relationships with targeted public sector entities (PSEs) and their representatives in Asia Pacific, including national governments, development partners, and public donors.

  • Support and record strategic, coordinated engagement approaches consistent with TNC standards for PSE engagement.

Enhancing internal capability

  • Add to and promote internal awareness and use of BBCRM, the HUB, and the guidance and tools archived in the Public Funding Knowledge Bank, relevant to public fundraising.

  • Manage and improve capacity building materials for designing and documenting conservation projects for public donors and deliver theory and practice training sessions and mentoring services to selected staff involved in public fundraising activities.

  • Provide subject matter expertise in presenting project designs in logical frameworks, drafting text related to managing the project’s risks, and describing project governance arrangements and approaches to monitoring and evaluation of project compliance and impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

Capacity Building

Enhance the capacity of TNC staff to:

  • Build and manage relationships with public sector entities.

  • Navigate public donor systems and requirements.

  • Develop competitive, fundable project designs and documents.

  • Support delivery and use of relevant tools, training, and learning platforms.

Project Design & Proposal Development

  • Support teams to design, document, and package projects for submission to public donors.

  • Strengthen quality, consistency, and competitiveness of proposals.

Internal Coordination & Approvals

  • Facilitate cross-functional coordination required for proposal development.

  • Support teams in securing internal approvals for submission to public donors.

  • Promote consistency and adherence to organizational processes.

Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain institutional knowledge of priority public donors in Asia Pacific.

  • Track donor priorities, processes, and engagement strategies.

  • Provide strategic advice on which public sector entities to prioritize for engagement.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in political science, environmental policy, international development, management or other relevant field and 5 years of government relations or corporate sector experience, or equivalent combination education/experience.

  • Fluency in English.

  • Analytical and project management experience. Demonstrated experience in successfully developing and implementing complex projects in an unstructured environment.

  • Experience developing, directing and managing multiple projects and implementing strategic program goals.

  • Proven communication and presentation skills.

  • Proven negotiation skills.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working with governments, public sector entities, or multilateral institutions.

  • Experience supporting relationships with external partner organisations, proposal development and/ or managing donor-funded projects.

  • Knowledge and expertise in developing theories of change, logical frameworks, result chains and related methodologies.

  • Experience working in Asia Pacific.

  • Familiarity with public funding mechanisms and agencies, including knowledge and application of current and evolving trends in public funding.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and management abilities.

  • Experience coordinating with people in difference locations and cultures.

Pay Grade : 8

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Network Security Architect to lead the security architecture for a large-scale network consolidation program at a US-based Tier-2 Telco. The role owns security design, firewall rule consolidation, and policy definition, focusing on transforming fragmented legacy security postures into a standardized target-state architecture executable at scale. This position is ideal for professionals experienced in large-scale firewall transformations who excel at simplifying complex rule sets and designing scalable, segmented security architectures.

Responsibilities

  • Translate enterprise-level security architecture into actionable, site-level security blueprints aligned with the overall program vision.
  • Define and document the target-state architecture for the Network Security domain, including firewall rule consolidation, VRF-based macro-segmentation, and DDoS mitigation strategies.
  • Analyze and optimize legacy security policies by consolidating overlapping firewall rules into streamlined, standardized templates.
  • Collaborate closely with client Security and CISO teams, supporting design validation, risk alignment, and compliance with regulatory frameworks (e.g., CISA, HIPAA).
  • Identify and resolve complex IP subnet overlaps and security-related routing conflicts flagged during data analysis phases.
  • Define clear security exit criteria and guardrails as part of the migration factory Definition of Done (DoD).
  • Contribute to architecture governance, including participation in architecture reviews, design approvals, and development of enterprise standards and reference architectures, while collaborating with cross-domain architects.
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise Network Security Architecture, with strong focus on large-scale firewall migrations and rule consolidation.
  • Deep expertise in NAT/PAT, VRF segmentation, Zero Trust frameworks, and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco).
  • Proven experience designing and integrating DDoS mitigation and traffic scrubbing solutions at network edges.
  • Strong ability to translate complex security policies into standardized, reusable Low-Level Design (LLD) templates suitable for automated deployment.
  • Solid understanding of compliance-driven architecture, with ability to align technical designs to regulatory frameworks while not owning final approvals.
  • Experience working within secure client environments (VDI/VPN) and adhering to strict change control processes without direct production access.
  • English proficiency at B2 (Upper-Intermediate) to C1 (Advanced) level, with strong spoken communication skills.

  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

jobs.description:
About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About the opportunity:

Homeward gives real estate agents a set of financial product solutions that help their clients move without the usual contingency headaches. We're growing and building the team that gets us to the next level. Fair warning: we don't have a marketing playbook yet. If that excites you, read on.

We’re looking for a Principal Integrated Marketer to help Homeward build trust and confidence with real estate agents. This is a player-coach role where you’ll both set the strategy and do a lot of the work yourself. Over time, that ratio will shift as we build out the marketing playbook and team.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the executive team (specifically, the CEO, Chief Growth Officer, and Chief Sales Officer) to translate business priorities into a clear marketing strategy
  • Drive demand generation and integrated marketing efforts across the company. You will be responsible for executing the strategy, defining KPIs, and reporting out on results to the executive team
  • Establish a trusted presence across channels where agents are gathering – organic and paid social media, brokerage networks, industry events, etc.
  • Build and manage a content engine across multiple formats (editorial, video, visual) and asset types (thought leadership, testimonials and social proof, educational webinars).
  • Experiment with new growth marketing strategies. For example, we’re interested in testing out an agent ambassador program and targeted paid campaigns to amplify content distribution or re-engage agents who have used it in the past. The marketing strategy will evolve over time as we learn what works and what doesn’t.
  • Leverage a combination of employees, contractors, and tools to build out a small but effective growth marketing team. We’ll want you to hire an experienced marketing team to provide the leverage needed.

How you’ll work:

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, comfortably shifting between setting direction and rolling up your sleeves to get the work done.
  • Create clarity and momentum in ambiguous environments, independently driving initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Operate with an ownership mindset, holding yourself accountable for business results rather than simply completing marketing activities.
  • Demonstrate exceptional judgment and ability to make thoughtful tradeoffs. For example, by knowing when speed matters more than perfection—and when precision is critical to the business.
  • Use customer insights, data, and sound business judgment to make decisions quickly, iterate often, and continuously improve results.
  • Build collaborative, cross-functional partnerships across executive leadership, Sales, and Product Management.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years experience in Marketing
  • A well-rounded marketing generalist that has experience driving integrated marketing plans across a breadth of channels, which might include content, organic and paid social, influencer / community networks, email, event marketing, and PR
  • Data-driven and excellent at defining, setting, and reporting on full-funnel KPIs
  • High creative and editorial standards – you’ll be responsible for managing content marketers / visual designers
  • Startup experience and scrappy mindset is a must. You need a self-starter mindset, who is excited to figure things out rather than inheriting a system.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills
  • Experience in real estate or financial products is a plus. And if not, the desire to dig in and deeply understand real estate agents and how to get them to trust and understand Homeward enough to try a complex financial product

Perks and Benefits

Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Annual performance bonus eligibility.
  • Meaningful equity grant – stock options with real upside potential.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage – with company contributions towards premiums.
  • Meaningful time off – including 20 days of paid vacation, 5 sick days, 12 company holidays, and 2 floating holidays.
  • Generous paid parental leave of up to 13 weeks.
  • 401(k) with employer contribution match.
  • Remote-first work environment (our headquarters are in Austin, TX).
  • Collaborative, low-ego team that values intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement.
  • See more about how Homeward takes care of our team here.

Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

Summary

The Director of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) is responsible for leading and optimizing Boulder Care's end-to-end revenue cycle operations to maximize cash collections, ensure compliant billing practices, and support sustainable financial performance. This role partners closely with Finance, Clinical Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and third-party vendors to improve processes, strengthen controls, and provide actionable financial insights.

The Director will directly supervise the Revenue Cycle Manager and provide strategic leadership over all aspects of patient billing, coding, collections, payer operations, revenue integrity, and revenue cycle analytics. The Director will also own the partnership with Candid and other technology vendors to optimize system functionality, automate workflows, and continuously improve the overall revenue cycle experience.

The position plays a critical role in supporting accurate financial reporting, improving key performance indicators, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations and payer requirements, and supporting Boulder Care's continued growth.

Core Responsibilities

Revenue Cycle Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all revenue cycle functions, including:
    • Charge capture
    • Coding support
    • Claims management
    • Payment posting
    • Denials management
    • Appeals
    • Collections
    • Revenue integrity
  • Develop and execute initiatives to improve revenue cycle performance, cash flow, and operational efficiency.
  • Establish measurable goals and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the revenue cycle organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional customer service.
  • Serve as Finance's executive leader for revenue cycle strategy, providing recommendations to the Controller and executive leadership regarding reimbursement trends, payer performance, cash flow optimization, and revenue cycle risks.

Financial Performance

  • Monitor revenue cycle performance through dashboards and analytics.
  • Analyze trends impacting revenue, collections, denial rates, aging, reimbursement, and payer performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve net collections and reduce revenue leakage.
  • Partner with Accounting during the monthly close process to support revenue recognition, accounts receivable valuation, allowance methodologies, and audit support.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning related to revenue operations.

Revenue Integrity & Compliance

  • Ensure billing and collection activities comply with:
    • Federal and state healthcare regulations
    • Medicare and Medicaid requirements
    • Commercial payer contracts
    • HIPAA

  • Maintain strong working relationships with Candid and other revenue cycle vendors to maximize system capabilities and operational efficiency.
  • Oversee third-party billing vendors and outsourced revenue cycle partners.
  • Ensure timely resolution of payer issues and escalated billing concerns.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Directly supervise the Revenue Cycle Manager.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop revenue cycle leaders and staff.
  • Establish performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
  • Build succession plans and support employee development.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional growth across the revenue cycle organization.

    • Accounting
    • FP&A
    • Clinical Operations
    • Credentialing
    • Provider Operations
    • Compliance
    • Product
    • Engineering

    • Healthcare reimbursement methodologies
    • Commercial insurance
    • Medicare
    • Medicaid
    • Value-based reimbursement models
  • Experience managing denials, collections, payer relationships, and revenue integrity initiatives.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret operational and financial metrics.
  • Experience working with healthcare billing systems and electronic health records (EHRs).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, leadership, and relationship management skills.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience with start ups, behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, or value-based care.
  • Experience utilizing Candid, Boulder Care's revenue cycle management platform, or similar web-based healthcare billing applications.

Шукаємо автора/ку курсу "Video Content Creator" — людина, яка вільно розмовляє "мовою відео" і готова навчити інших створювати контент, який не просто «прокручують», а доглядають до кінця, коментують і купують.

Ми у Projector Instituteстворюємо освіту, яка справді змінює кар’єрні траєкторії.

Якщо тине просто відеограф, а сучасний медіамейкер, який/ка знає, як змусити алгоритми працювати на себе - ми шукаємо саме тебе!

(на створення курсу передбачено 1-2 місяці, викладання триває ще 2-3 місяці у форматі живих онлайн лекцій та перевірки домашніх завдань)

Кого ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеальногоавтора/ку курсу "Video Content Creator":
— Ти добре розумієш цикл: Ідея → постановка → зйомка → монтаж → оформлення → публікація → аналіз.
— Практикуючий Creator: У тебе є успішні кейси в TikTok, Reels або YouTube (власні канали або клієнтські проєкти з реальними цифрами охоплень).
— AI-enthusiast: Ти вже інтегрував/ла штучний інтелект у свій робочий процес. Ти не пишеш сценарії по 3 години, бо знаєш, як дати правильний промпт ChatGPT, і не чистиш звук вручну, бо знаєш про AI-шумодави.
— Майстер і мобільного продакшну також: Ти можеш зняти шедевр на iPhone або Android, використовуючи лише підручне світло та бюджетний мікрофон.
— Стратег: Ти розумієш різницю між «просто гарним відео» та відео-воронкою, яка перетворює глядача на лояльного клієнта.
— Монтаж: Досконале володіння CapCut (desktop/mobile) та буде плюсом знання десктопних редакторів.
— Маєш готовність ділитися досвідом через реальні кейси, особисті лайфхаки та практичні завдання.
— В тебе легко вдається передати іншим свій ентузіазм та любов до створення відео-контенту та його продакшн.

Просто чудово і буде перевагою, коли ти також:
— вмієш працювати з аудиторією, давати якісний зворотний зв'язок, вести дискусії та модерувати обговорення на рівних
— вже взаємодіяв/ла з нашим Інститутом раніше.

Якщо коротко, то загалом будуть 2 основні задачі:
1. Написання програми курсу (розробити ідею курсової роботи, розробити домашні завдання та наповнити курс матеріалами для вебінарів)
2. Проведення самого курсу (онлайн вебінари (2 раз на тиждень), перевірка та фідбек на домашні завдання, комунікація з студентами).

Дізнатися більше про кураторство вProjector Institute — клац.

Бути частиною команди — це:
— мати цілковиту довіру та допомогу у разі потреби від команди (маємо корпоративні лекції, як допоможуть стати і бути найкращім автором та куратором);
— мати можливість вдосконалювати свої навички комунікації, наставництва та педагогіки;
— бути в оточені людей, які закохані у свою справу;
— мати гнучкий графік (часткова зайнятість, що дає змогу поєднувати з іншими заняттями);
— мати знижку на всі освітні продукти Projector та корпоративну підписку на Projector Library.
Якщо все вище тобі відгукується і ти справді прагнеш ділитися своїм досвідом та навчати колег створювати віральний контент за допомогою технологій майбутнього, а не просто робити нудні відео за застарілими шаблонами десятирічної давнини —надсилай резюме, заповнюй коротку форму та давай знайомитись!

Так, Вільна Освіта, яка допомагає людям будувати карʼєру на ринку tech&creative професій – існує. І саме ти можеш стати рушієм її вдосконалення та масштабування.

Долучайся до Projector Institute!

jobs.description:
Instructions

In your cover letter, tell us:
  • Why Kagi’s mission and this role resonate with you
  • How your experience maps to what we describe (with concrete examples)
  • Which challenges you’re most excited to tackle

About Kagi

Kagi is your companion for a better web. We're building a friendly internet where you can explore, learn, and interact with confidence - free from ads, tracking, and distractions. Kagi builds advanced, user-centric technology to empower you, not replace you. Our products include Kagi Search, Orion browser, Kagi Assistant, Kagi News, Kagi Summarizer, and Kagi Translate. Every product reflects our commitment to a surveillance-free internet, designed around the user.

About the Role

Kagi grows differently than most consumer products. We don't buy ads, we don't track users across the web to retarget them, and we don't have a growth team chasing vanity metrics. We grow because people try Kagi, feel the difference, and tell other people. Our job in marketing is to make that loop faster and wider: get the right people to try it, help them understand why it's worth paying for, and keep them around.
This is a generalist growth role for someone who's comfortable working across content, user lifecycle, (analytics), and social media. You'll have real autonomy and real ownership, and expected to make bets with product-adjacent growth experiments - picking whatever lever matters most this week and pulling it yourself.
Day-to-day, as a part of the marketing team you will:
  • Own the user acquisition and conversion funnel end to end: from how people first hear about Kagi to converting a trial into a paid subscriber
  • Write and ship content - blog posts, landing pages, comparison pages, email campaigns - that explains why Kagi is worth paying for in a market full of free alternatives
  • Build and improve lifecycle marketing: onboarding sequences, activation nudges, win-back campaigns, and renewal/retention messaging
  • Dig into analytics yourself: track funnel performance, find drop-off points, and turn data into a prioritized list of experiments
  • Run growth experiments end to end - hypothesis, build, measure, iterate - without needing a dedicated analytics or engineering team to do it for you
  • Partner with product and design to influence onboarding flows, pricing pages, and in-product moments that affect conversion and retention
  • Represent the user's voice in growth decisions, consistent with Kagi's position as a privacy-respecting, user-funded product - we grow by earning trust, not by exploiting attention

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in a growth, performance, or full-funnel marketing role at a subscription or SaaS product, with real ownership of outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across content, analytics, and lifecycle/email marketing without a large team behind you
  • Strong writing - you can produce clear, persuasive copy yourself, not just brief someone else to do it
  • Experience running and analyzing growth experiments (A/B tests, lifecycle campaigns, landing page iterations) and knowing when to kill an experiment versus scale it
  • High comfort with ambiguity: you can take "conversion is too low" and turn it into a concrete plan without a lot of hand-holding
  • Genuine interest in privacy-respecting products - you'll need to grow Kagi without the ad-tracking playbook most growth marketers default to

Job Title:

Social Creative Manager (Remote)

Job Description

We're looking for a Social Content Creator with serious creative chops and a strong strategic instinct. Someone who can look at what's happening in culture, in the industry, and in the feed and turn it into dynamic social content that makes Concentrix impossible to scroll past.
This isn't about managing channels or scheduling posts. It's about bringing creative ideas to life: translating strategy into visuals, messaging, and formats that actually land. You'll work closely with the Associate Director of Social and two content creators, contributing to content direction while owning the creative execution that makes it real.

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

About the Role

We're looking for a Social Content Creator with serious creative chops and a strong strategic instinct. Someone who can look at what's happening in culture, in the industry, and in the feed and turn it into dynamic social content that makes Concentrix impossible to scroll past.

This isn't about managing channels or scheduling posts. It's about bringing creative ideas to life: translating strategy into visuals, messaging, and formats that actually land. You'll work closely with the Associate Director of Social and two content creators, contributing to content direction while owning the creative execution that makes it real.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

  • Translate brand and campaign strategy into creative social content across LinkedIn, short-form video, carousels, and written posts
  • Spot trending topics and cultural moments and move fast, turning them into dynamic, on-brand social pieces before the moment passes
  • Develop content ideas and creative concepts that reflect a challenger brand perspective, not a corporate one
  • Bring visual thinking to the table: not just what we say, but how it looks and feels across platforms
  • Collaborate with content creators and the wider social team to brief, shape, and elevate execution
  • Contribute to content strategy discussions, bringing a creative POV to planning conversations
  • Use performance data to sharpen creative decisions over time

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:

  • 4–5+ years in social content, creative social, or content production, ideally with agency experience or a background that has spanned both strategy and hands-on creative
  • Someone who lives in the social feed and knows instinctively what makes content cut through, across B2B and culture
  • Strong across formats: you can write a sharp caption, brief a visual concept, and think in video
  • A creative who can move fast without losing quality; reactive content is part of the job
  • Comfortable contributing to strategy without needing to own it; you bring ideas and POV, not just execution
  • At home in a distributed global team, collaborating across time zones

What This Is Not

This is not a social media management role, and it's not a pure strategy role either. If your experience is primarily scheduling content, managing community, or writing decks without making things, this probably isn't the right fit. We need someone who can think and create, and who gets genuinely excited about both.

What’s in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

Power the best version of you!

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Global Pricing Analytics Lead – Manager

Live

What you will do

The Team

  • Contribute to GOP initiatives and improvement projects based on business needs

  • Strategic Advice & Planning for New Launches

  • Depending on experience and interest, contribute to new reimbursement submissions, indication expansions, LOE (loss of exclusivity) readiness, broader pricing/access strategic planning

Win

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek has the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or greater in a related field (e.g., finance, medicine, pharmacy, biology, economics, engineering, etc.)

  • Minimum 3 years of directly related experience in Pricing, Financial Audit, Finance Analysis, Sales & Marketing Effectiveness, Forecasting, or Consulting

  • Experience of cross-border pricing risk management (IRP, LSO, Price Floors, Gross to Net optimisation)

  • Strong technical skills in data analysis, forecasting, and advanced Excel usage

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken

  • Strong analytical capability—able to simplify complex issues and propose clear recommendations

  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and precision

  • Strong project management skills with a structured work approach

  • Prior pharmaceutical pricing experience

  • Understanding of HTA and Health Economics

  • Experience working in cross-functional, virtual global teams

  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify issues and implement solutions

  • Solid understanding of global pricing and reimbursement systems, healthcare, market and competitor trends

  • Prior commercial or consulting experience is a plus

Thrive

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Position Summary

McKesson Corporation is seeking talented Software Developer to join our Supply Chain Technology team with a strong background in microservices architecture, system integrations, CP4D, Apache Kafka, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). This role is ideal for someone with 4+ years of hands-on development experience who thrives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, intelligent systems that power modern enterprise applications and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using modern frameworks and cloud-native technologies.

  • Design and implement real-time data streaming solutions using Apache Kafka.

  • Build robust integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, messaging queues, and middleware.

  • Collaborate with AI/ML teams to embed intelligent features into applications, including predictive analytics, NLP, and automation.

  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines using CP4D.

  • Write and optimize SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers in Oracle.

  • Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability of distributed systems.

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and CI/CD.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems, ensuring uptime and responsiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.

Critical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS).

  • Proficient in ETL development, Oracle performance tuning, and complex SQL.

  • Deep understanding of Apache Kafka for event-driven and real-time data processing.

  • Experience implementing AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in teams

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in healthcare or supply chain domain.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge of API gateways, service mesh, and observability tools.

  • Experience with MLOps and deploying AI models in production environments.

  • Certifications in cloud, Kafka, or AI technologies.

  • Exposure to data engineering and big data tools (e.g., Spark, Flink).

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

About McKesson Medical-Surgical
McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS) is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers.

Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we partner with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 280,000 SKUs of branded and private-label medical-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID-19 tests.

Looking Ahead: A New Chapter for MMS
McKesson has announced its intent to separate MMS into an independent company by taking it public through an initial public offering (IPO). The separation could be completed by the second half of calendar year 2027, pending market factors and regulatory approvals. This is an exciting evolution that builds on MMS’s strong foundation and proven leadership in the Alternate Care space. As a standalone company, MMS would be positioned to unlock new opportunities to innovate, grow and lead with even greater agility and focus. We will also continue to be one of the largest medical-surgical distributors in the U.S., with over $11B in annual sales. This separation would accelerate our mission and empower us to shape a future defined by customer-centricity, bold thinking and operational excellence. For job seekers, it’s a unique moment to join a team that’s already making a meaningful impact and leading the way in shaping the future of healthcare delivery in Alternate Care settings – with even greater opportunity ahead as we prepare to become an independent company.

We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Data Architect will analyze, design, and implement scalable data architectures and data models within cloud-based platforms. This hands-on technical role translates business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, and high-performing data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and operational data products. Working with data architects, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders, the Data Architect develops models, architectures, and frameworks that enable data-driven decision-making while aligning with enterprise standards, governance practices, and evolving business needs.

What you will do:

  • Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights, and translate them into scalable data architectures and models.
  • Design and implement end-to-end data architectures supporting ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption for analytics and operational use cases.
  • Develop and maintain logical and physical data models, data flows, and architecture documentation.
  • Create and optimize data models to support dashboards, reporting, and data visualization tools.
  • Apply modern data architecture patterns, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, batch and event-driven processing, and change data capture.
  • Design cloud-native and cloud-compatible solutions, including data platform modernization and migration strategies.
  • Ensure data solutions adhere to governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Design for scalability, reliability, and performance, including partitioning strategies and schema optimization.
  • Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver aligned data solutions.
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, identifying risks, trade-offs, and optimization opportunities.
  • Support DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and team members on data architecture and modeling best practices.
  • Translate business requirements into data quality standards and actionable data solutions.
  • Continuously refine models, methodologies, and architectures based on feedback and evolving business needs.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 7-10 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or related technical roles, including a minimum of 5+ years in a data-centric role.
  • Strong experience in data modeling, including logical and physical modeling, and use of data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, ERwin, or PowerDesigner.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, DB2, or Redshift.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and data services, including AWS, Azure, or GCP, and big data frameworks such as EMR or Spark.
  • Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, and streaming platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed data processing, data integration, and NoSQL technologies, including graph, key-value, and columnar technologies.
  • Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau, Cognos, BusinessObjects, MicroStrategy, SAS, or SPSS.
  • Proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, data privacy, and security practices.
  • Experience with DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
