About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

We are seeking a high-performing, experienced Inside Sales Representative (ISR) to accelerate Galileo's growth within the large employer market. This is not a traditional SDR role—we're looking for an experienced sales professional who understands healthcare benefits, can engage senior decision-makers, and consistently generates high-quality sales opportunities.

The ISR will own both outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification for employers with 1,000+ employees. Working closely with Enterprise Sales Executives, Marketing, and Consultant Relations, this individual will identify target accounts, execute strategic outreach campaigns, conduct meaningful discovery conversations, qualify opportunities, and deliver sales-qualified leads (SQLs) that convert into pipeline.

Success in this role requires persistence, strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the employer healthcare and benefits landscape.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Pipeline Generation

  • Develop and execute outbound prospecting strategies targeting employers with 1,000+ employees.
  • Qualify and convert inbound marketing leads into sales-qualified opportunities.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of target accounts aligned to Galileo's Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
  • Research organizations, benefits strategies, consultants, and key decision makers to personalize outreach.
  • Execute multi-channel prospecting campaigns including phone, email, LinkedIn, events, webinars, and referrals.

Opportunity Qualification

  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand employer priorities, healthcare challenges, benefit strategies, and buying readiness.
  • Identify key business pain points, decision-makers, budget, timing, and competitive landscape.
  • Apply a disciplined qualification methodology (MEDDPICC or similar) to determine opportunity quality.
  • Ensure opportunities meet agreed qualification standards before transitioning to Enterprise Sales.

Sales Collaboration

  • Schedule qualified meetings for Enterprise Sales Executives.
  • Prepare detailed opportunity notes, account intelligence, and discovery findings prior to handoff.
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Sales, Marketing, Consultant Relations, and Sales Operations to maximize conversion rates.
  • Participate in pipeline reviews and continuously refine targeting strategies.

CRM & Process Excellence

  • Maintain accurate activity tracking and opportunity management within Salesforce.
  • Document discovery, qualification, outreach cadence, and next steps.
  • Monitor lead progression and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Continuously improve outreach messaging, conversion rates, and prospect engagement.

About You

You know the difference between a sales-ready lead and a warm name on a list. You can hold your own with a VP of Total Rewards talking through self-funded strategy, then hand the enterprise sales team an opportunity brief sharp enough that they walk into the room already prepared. Budget, timing, decision-maker, competition, pain: you get to the truth on all of it before you call something qualified.

You don't just work a queue. You notice what's slowing the pipeline down, fix it, and make the people around you faster.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

  • 3+ years of successful Inside Sales, Business Development, or Sales Development experience.
  • Demonstrated success generating enterprise sales opportunities for complex B2B solutions.
  • Experience selling into large employers (1,000+ employees).
  • Healthcare industry experience required.
  • Experience selling one or more of the following: Primary Care, Virtual Care, Healthcare Navigation, Digital Health, Employer Benefits Solutions, Population Health, Benefit Point Solutions
  • Proven history of exceeding lead generation and pipeline creation goals.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% and authorization to work in the United States
  • Preferred: Experience selling to Benefits Leaders, HR Executives, Total Rewards, Finance, or Procurement.
  • Preferred: Knowledge of employer-sponsored healthcare, self-funded employers, consultants, TPAs, and health plans.
  • Preferred: Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and modern sales engagement platforms.
  • Preferred: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or structured sales qualification methodologies.

Compensation: $75,000 per year based upon prior experience, performance, and market dynamics. This role is eligible for variable compensation. OTE is ~$100k.

Benefits Offered:

  • Medical / Dental / Vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account + match
  • Company paid STD/LTD, AD&D, and Life insurance
  • Paid Family Leave
  • 401K + match

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Sr. AWS Cloud Architect to design, lead, and govern enterprise cloud architecture supporting mission-critical federal programs. Responsibilities

  • Systems Design: Design and document scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures (blueprints, diagrams, and strategies) on AWS, with secondary integration and support for Azure workloads
  • Compliant Architecture: Develop and implement reference architectures and design patterns aligned to FedRAMP Moderate control baselines (NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171)
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead cloud migration and modernization strategy, including workload assessment, right-sizing, and cost optimization
  • Cost & Performance Optimization: Evaluate and recommend cloud-native and hybrid solutions that balance performance, cost, and compliance
  • ATO & System Security Plans: Lead technical gap analysis, partner with the cloud security team, execute automated control mapping, and support development and maintenance of System Security Plans (SSPs), architecture diagrams, and other ATO documentation
  • Automation (IaC): Develop and implement reusable Infrastructure as Code templates using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation to ensure continuous compliance and rapid deployment
  • DevSecOps Integration: Configure secure CI/CD pipelines, monitoring solutions, and containerization using tools such as Azure DevOps and AWS-native services (CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy) and other security tooling
  • Identity & Data Protection: Architect secure identity access boundaries, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on (SSO), network firewalls, and encryption schemas for data at rest and in transit
  • SRE & Disaster Recovery: Build site reliability engineering (SRE) practices and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Technical Mentorship: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cloud engineers

Qualifications

  • US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
  • Minimum 12 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience), Min 10 years with MS/MA

  • Scripting experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Experience with cloud-native and serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, microservices) and containerization (EKS, ECS, Fargate)
  • Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, SSO/MFA, Azure Policy, Site-to-Site VPN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect)
  • Experience implementing SRE practices and disaster recovery plans
  • Experience supporting ATO and continuous monitoring processes with government customers
  • Certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional

  • Experience with Databricks implementation and support
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification
  • Experience with Microsoft .NET and SQL Server
  • Experience with Azure

  • Send loan applications promptly and track them through to completion, no lead falls through the cracks.

Brainrider is a marketing and creative agency with teams in Menlo Park/San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle, New York City, London, and Toronto. We work with ambitious marketers, in-house creative teams, and internal agencies to do more, by filling capability and capacity gaps and enabling them to execute their marketing and creative at scale.

We believe collaboration is at its best when we feel at home, so we work as a team — plain and simple. Whether we’re brainstorming better marketing ideas for our clients, or pushing the gas to meet a tight deadline, it all happens with adaptability, optimism, and teamwork.

Are you our next team member?

The Role

Job Title:Senior Performance Marketing Specialist

Length: Thru end of year, with possibility of extension

Location: Remote, US

Salary Range: $125K-135K

Brainrider is looking for a detail-obsessed Senior Performance Marketing Specialist to own the strategy, quality, and performance of our paid acquisition efforts across search, video, social, and emerging digital channels. This is an execution-heavy role for someone who thrives in the weeds — scrutinizing campaign setups, catching what others miss, and holding agency partners to the highest standard of performance and accuracy.

The ideal candidate comes from an agency background where they've managed multi-channel performance campaigns across a diverse client portfolio, giving them the platform expertise and operational rigor to know exactly what "good" looks like — and the conviction to flag when it doesn't. You'll work closely with our agency partner(s) to ensure flawless execution across paid search, programmatic, and non-traditional media channels, making this a role for someone who combines deep SEM expertise with a QA-first mindset and proactive communication style.

What you'll do

Agency Management & Quality Assurance (Primary Focus)

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for agency partner(s) managing paid search, video, social, and programmatic campaigns — setting expectations, defining priorities, holding them accountable to SLAs and optimization cadences, and proactively surfacing gaps or underperformance rather than waiting to be asked
  • Own rigorous QA of all agency output — campaign builds, keyword lists, bid strategies, audience targeting, ad copy, tracking/tagging, and budget pacing — before anything goes live
  • Review creative assets against platform specs and safe zones before launch — you're the person who catches that the logo is getting clipped on mobile, the headline is truncating at 28 characters instead of 30, or the CTA button is overlapping body text in the ad preview. If it's not pixel-perfect, it doesn't go live
  • Enforce strict naming conventions across campaigns, ad groups, creatives, and UTMs — you're the reason the account is navigable, reportable, and audit-ready six months from now
  • Maintain a "tight ship" operating cadence — campaign taxonomy is clean, naming is consistent, folders are organized, documentation is current, and nothing launches without a final preflight check

Paid Search and Paid Social Strategy & Oversight (Core Expertise)

  • Own the paid search strategy across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max), Microsoft Ads, and other SEM platforms — defining keyword architecture, match type strategy, bid frameworks, and budget allocation
  • Own paid social strategy across Meta, Reddit, X, TikTok, and more.
  • Drive the experimentation roadmap — define what gets tested (ad copy, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, landing pages), hold the agency to rigorous test design, and ensure learnings are documented and actioned
  • Manage and optimize significant monthly budgets with a focus on efficiency metrics (CPA, ROAS, LTV/CAC, payback periods) while maintaining aggressive growth targets

Reporting, Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards and performance frameworks that enable fast, informed decision-making
  • Deliver proactive status updates, performance insights, and risk flags to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Translate complex campaign data into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product marketing, and growth partners

Non-Traditional Media Buying & Programmatic (Secondary Focus — 15%)

  • Oversee agency execution of programmatic campaigns across DSPs (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360) including audience targeting, contextual placements, and retargeting
  • Source, negotiate, and manage direct media buys across newsletters, industry publications, trade journals, and niche/specialty developer-focused sites
  • Identify and test emerging channels — evaluate ROI potential of new placements, sponsorships, and partnership opportunities outside core social/search platforms

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years of performance marketing experience with deep expertise in SEM/paid search (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360) — you know these platforms inside and out
  • Agency background strongly preferred — you've managed multiple accounts/clients simultaneously and understand the pace, rigor, and accountability that agency life demands. You know what great agency work looks like because you've done it yourself
  • Meticulous attention to detail that borders on compulsive — you catch the creative safe zone violation in ad preview, the naming convention break in row 847 of the bulk sheet, the UTM parameter that doesn't match the taxonomy doc. You don't just spot errors; you're personally offended by them
  • Proven ability to manage and QA agency partners — you've held external teams accountable, given direct and specific feedback, and maintained high standards without micromanaging
  • Track record managing substantial paid media budgets ($+/month) with clear performance outcomes and efficient spend allocation
  • Proactive communicator — you default to over-communicating, surfacing issues early, and keeping stakeholders informed without being asked. You bring solutions, not just flags
  • Strong analytical skills (Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or similar) — comfortable with data, attribution modeling, and translating performance data into actionable optimization strategies
  • Experience with A/B and multivariate testing methodologies across creative, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies

Bonus

  • Experience marketing to developer or technical audiences (developers, engineers, data scientists) — you understand how they move through paid funnels differently than consumer audiences
  • Knowledge of MMPs and mobile attribution (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust) for app-based campaigns

Additional Information

We offer competitive salaries, paid vacation, work from home (WFH) support and set-up assistance, and a wide variety of other great perks!

  • You can learn more about working with us at Brainrider Careers

We respect and value the unique characteristics, skills, and experiences of everyone, and support and champion each other to be the best we can be — for ourselves, our team, and our clients.   • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, project leadership, and problem-solving skills.

  • Trust: earning trust through integrity, expertise, and acting in the client's best interest.
  • Innovation: continuously seeking out ways to better serve clients.
  • Excellence: holding ourselves to high standards in everything we do.
  • Results: moving with purpose to deliver meaningful outcomes.

  • Delivers complex security initiatives with strong planning, communication, documentation, testing, and post-implementation validation.
  • Reduces manual security work through automation and modern engineering practices.

About Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) at Cloudera

Cloudera’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function sits within the Applied AI organization, and is a specialized AI/ML engineering team focused on accelerating AI adoption within our most strategic enterprise customers. We embed directly with customers to rapidly pilot AI use cases, solve real-world business challenges, and help operationalize advanced AI capabilities within enterprise environments.

Cloudera FDEs operate at the intersection of customer engineering, AI innovation, and enterprise deployment - driving high-impact AI outcomes for customers and codifying solution patterns for repeatable delivery at scale.

About the role

Cloudera is looking for a seasoned full-stack ML engineer who can embed with customers to design technical use cases, and ship scalable enterprise AI/ML solutions on Cloudera.

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build & Prototype AI Apps - Develop full-stack AI/ML applications on Cloudera to demonstrate how AI and agentic systems solve real enterprise use cases

  • Partner with Strategic Customers - Work directly with customer teams to drive AI and agentic use cases from early prototype toward production readiness

jobs.excerpt: Description﻿Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose.  Powered by Clinical Expertise.
jobs.description:
Description

﻿Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise.

Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations.

Excellence starts with our people.

WE OFFER

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Benefits include healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, a generous 401 (k) match, paid vacation, personal time, and holidays.
  • Growth and training opportunities.
  • An award-winning remote work environment

POSITION OVERVIEW

Our Principal Cloud Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and platforms across the organization.

In this role, you will serve as the organization's senior technical authority for cloud architecture and infrastructure, bringing extensive expertise to establish engineering standards and governance, and to lead complex cloud initiatives from design through delivery.

Beyond technical leadership, you will mentor and guide the Systems Administration and Information Security teams, ensuring knowledge is shared through documentation, standards, and coaching. You will translate complex technical concepts into clear business and operational decisions, provide leadership during critical production events, and set the benchmark for engineering excellence.

Roles:

  • Serve as the highest-level technical authority and subject matter expert for all Azure cloud infrastructure and architecture
  • Define cloud engineering standards, architectural patterns, and governance practices that the organization adopts and follows
  • Own and lead cloud infrastructure projects end-to-end — from design and planning through execution, delivery, and post-deployment operations
  • Support the Manager of IT & IS on cloud strategy, architecture roadmap, and platform investment decisions
  • Mentor and develop the Systems Administration and Information Security teams — building organizational cloud competency through hands-on guidance, deliberate coaching, and knowledge transfer
  • Participate in evaluating and onboarding new cloud engineering talent as the team grows
  • Collaborate with Development teams to design and deliver application infrastructure on Azure
  • Provide Tier 2/3 escalation support to the IT Help Desk for complex infrastructure and cloud issues
  • Partner with the Information Security team to implement and evidence compliance controls for HITRUST 11.3r2 and SOC2

Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

  • Architect, deploy, and manage a secure Azure cloud environment including hub-spoke network topology, Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, API Management, and Private Endpoints
  • Define and enforce cloud governance standards including subscription management, Azure Policy, resource organization, tagging taxonomy, and cost management across all environments
  • Establish and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Azure Bicep) practices including module structure, state management, review workflow, and environment promotion — ensuring all infrastructure changes are version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and auditable with no undocumented manual changes in production
  • Build and own CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments with automated security scanning, testing, and progressive delivery
  • Establish change management and release governance processes ensuring all infrastructure changes are reviewable, approved, and auditable in a regulated healthcare environment — without becoming a bottleneck
  • Lead cloud migration projects — assess workloads, develop migration strategies, execute cutovers, validate post-migration health, and decommission legacy infrastructure
  • Design and deliver Azure infrastructure for new application onboarding; create reusable patterns and templates the team follows for future workloads
  • Manage hybrid connectivity including ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, and site-to-site connectivity between Azure and on-premises environments
  • Design and maintain cloud observability covering metrics, logs, and alerting with SLOs that reflect real operational impact — ensuring the team catches issues before they affect the business
  • Establish formal incident response processes including runbooks, escalation paths, and post-incident reviews; own disaster recovery and business continuity planning with defined and tested RPO/RTO targets
  • Manage Azure identity and access architecture including Entra ID, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Key Vault, and Managed Identities
  • Implement cloud security controls as defined by the Information Security team; build audit logging, evidence generation, and access-review processes that satisfy HITRUST 11.3r2, SOC2, and HIPAA requirements and hold up during audits
  • Manage DNS, certificate lifecycle, and network connectivity supporting data exchange with payers, health plans, and external partners
  • Develop scripting and automation solutions (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) to reduce manual operational burden and improve team efficiency
  • Define the engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation the team inherits; manage infrastructure and platform vendor relationships and SLAs
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation — architecture diagrams, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and how-to guides — that build team knowledge and reduce key-person dependency
  • Support after-hours availability and on-call response for critical infrastructure events as requested
  • Complete other duties as requested

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • 7–10 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering.
  • 5 years of senior or principal-level experience in Microsoft Azure
  • Demonstrated experience building or establishing a cloud engineering practice or function — not just operating an existing one; comfort setting standards others follow
  • Expert-level knowledge of Azure networking including hub-spoke topology, Virtual Networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, ExpressRoute, Private Endpoints, and DNS
  • Proven ability to independently architect Azure environments — designing governance, security, and operational frameworks from the ground up, not inheriting them
  • Expert-level experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Azure Bicep), including module design, state management, CI/CD integration, and enforcement of no-manual-change disciplines
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipeline tooling (Azure DevOps, GitLab, or GitHub Actions), including automated security scanning and progressive delivery practices
  • Demonstrated experience leading cloud migration projects, including workload assessment, planning, execution, and legacy decommission
  • Strong project leadership — able to own and drive multiple complex initiatives simultaneously with minimal oversight
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop technical staff across multiple teams; experience building organizational capability through deliberate knowledge transfer and hands-on coaching
  • Experience establishing incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices with defined and tested RPO/RTO targets
  • Expert-level knowledge of Azure identity and security services, including Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud
  • Strong networking and security fundamentals: network segmentation, secrets management, least-privilege access, and certificate lifecycle management
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language (PowerShell, Python, or Bash)
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (HITRUST, SOC2, HIPAA) with experience building audit evidence processes that hold up under scrutiny
  • Clear written communication and sound judgment under production pressure — able to make decisions and convey technical context to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions preferred
  • Experience with Azure AI and platform services preferred
  • Familiarity with healthcare data exchange standards (EDI, HL7, or SFTP-based interfaces) preferred

﻿Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) required — must already hold
  • AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate) required — must already hold
  • AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert) required — must already hold
  • AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert) strongly preferred

Work Environment:

Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity grant, and a comprehensive benefits package. In accordance with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law, we are providing a good-faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as their experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Compensation may grow over time through merit-based increases, promotions, and company-wide adjustments. If your salary expectations fall outside this range, we still encourage you to apply so we can have a conversation.

jobs.title: Trial Site Solutions Director
jobs.excerpt: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care.
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Trial Site Solutions Director to develop, build, and scale the Beacon Trial Site Network (TSN), a strategic initiative that brings together two sides of Beacon's footprint: our Clinical Trials business, where hundreds of trial sites have run and are running studies with the Waveband EEG headband with direction from our Global Clinical Operations team, and our Diagnostics business, where hundreds of hospital systems and clinics use our Home Sleep Tests to support the diagnosis of apnea. The TSN is focused on recognizing high-quality sites for execution excellence and providing them a network to support future pharmaceutical clinical trials and academic grant-funded studies, and to service diagnostic patients.

This Director will serve as the lead and coordinator of all TSN activities: setting the strategic direction of the network, growing and communicating with it, designing the incentives and recognition that drive membership and engagement, maximizing the scientific and clinical value from the relationships already in place, and directing the product and engineering work needed to support the network at scale. The role reports directly to the Chief Business Officer and coordinates closely with a matrixed working team spanning Clinical Operations, Business Development, Diagnostics, Product/Engineering, Marketing, and Legal. While this role starts with no direct reports, with demonstrated success it will hire a supporting team.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based near Beacon HQ in Boston, or another Beacon hub (e.g., New York City). Some travel required to sites, sponsors, and internal hubs should be expected.

What success looks like

  • Strategy and direction: Define the strategic vision and multi-year direction for the TSN, setting priorities, sequencing, and the long-term shape of the network in partnership with Life Sciences and Diagnostics leadership.
  • Product vision: Set the product vision for TSN-supporting platform capabilities, translating requirements from Life Sciences and Diagnostics into a single, coherent roadmap.
  • Cross-functional coordination with Product and Engineering: Work with Beacon's engineering teams to prioritize the platform capabilities that the TSN needs, informing product and holding development teams accountable by acting as primary stakeholder and advocate for site-facing capabilities on Beacon's product roadmaps.
  • Enrollment and Recruitment support: Build and oversee a patient recruitment capability that gives sponsors confidence in and supports sites’ ability to enroll for a given study, using EHR-based patient matching, patient-specific tokenized data, historical performance, site capacity, or other relevant data as inputs.
  • Pipeline and study routing: Match potential sponsor and study demand to qualified member sites, and own the process that routes opportunities into the network.
  • Commercial terms of membership: Define and own the commercial terms of network membership, evaluate options, and drive a decision for how membership can carry economic value for sites (e.g., networking experience, sharing best practices for clinical trial execution and practices for diagnostic patients, recognition and visibility, insights into Beacon product direction, or access to a peer community) and for Beacon (data quality and speed, protocol compliance, sponsor confidence, increased patients served), and continually refine both sides of that exchange.
  • Institutional and health system relationships: Own relationships at the institutional level, including health system contracting, IRB coordination, and master service agreements, alongside relationships with individual investigators and coordinators.
  • Network growth and ownership: Own the roadmap and operating model for the TSN, taking it from an early framework to a fully operating network with clear offerings, targets, and milestones.
  • Sourcing and qualification: Direct the sourcing methodology for candidate sites, and refine the qualification and certification criteria that define different tiers of membership.
  • Communication and relationship management: Own the site-facing voice of the TSN, including outreach, onboarding, ongoing check-ins, recertification communications, and the broader library of templates and touchpoints that keep the relationship feeling like a genuine partnership.
  • Governance and reporting: Establish the KPIs, review cadence, decision rights, and upgrade and downgrade pathways between membership tiers, giving Beacon leadership clear, ongoing visibility into network value delivered, growth, and health.
  • Sponsor and CRO positioning: Shape how TSN membership is represented to sponsors and CROs as evidence of site readiness, data quality, and faster study start-up, strengthening Beacon's position as a site-centric partner.

What you will bring

  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare, clinical trials, diagnostics, or another regulated healthcare environment, including at least 3 years in a role focused on building, growing, or scaling a network, community, or partner program involving clinics or trial sites.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale a structured program or network from an early framework to full operation, including defining qualification criteria, incentive structures, and a repeatable operating cadence.
  • Strong cross-functional influence skills, with a track record of coordinating engineering, product, marketing, and legal stakeholders toward a shared roadmap, driving progress without relying on direct authority. even without direct authority over those teams.
  • Comfort working with data to track performance, calibrate qualification criteria, and report on program health.
  • Experience negotiating or structuring commercial terms with institutional partners, such as health systems, site networks, or similar organizations, including contracts, MSAs, or revenue-sharing arrangements.
  • Familiarity with clinical trial site feasibility and enrollment considerations, and the ability to translate them into criteria, tooling, or process.
  • Familiarity with CRM and project management tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with quality or compliance data (e.g., protocol deviations, data quality metrics, CAPA findings) to inform tiering or certification decisions' - since the success criteria explicitly mention data quality and protocol compliance as inputs to qualification, and that data currently lives with ClinOps/QA, not with a network/BD function.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write outreach, recognition, and relationship communications that feel personal and credible to a scientific and clinical audience.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward simplicity and scalability in program design, comfortable turning an early-stage, evolving framework into durable infrastructure.
  • Empathy for stakeholders across the network, including trial site investigators and coordinators, sponsors, internal commercial and clinical teams, and, most of all, patients.

The base salary range for this role is determined based on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes an incentive compensation plan, equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and, most of all, a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Executive Director, Quality Systems GxP Platform Lead

Job Location: Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you will help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Executive Director, GxP Quality Execution Platforms

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the strategy, operating model, and lifecycle ownership for enterprise GxP Quality Execution Platforms. This role converts core quality processes from manual, process-centric execution into scalable, workflow-, rule-, and data-driven digital platforms that are inspection-ready, adoption-led, and aligned with the GxP Quality Operating Model.

Responsibilities:

  • Operationalize the GxP Quality Operating Model vision and strategy evolving from digitized Quality Management System through AI-enabled to advanced AI-orchestrated with full autonomy across foundational quality processes. Relevant to that, own business strategy includes driving development and endorsement of business case needs for funding, roadmap, and lifecycle governance for enterprise GxP quality execution platforms, including event and issue management, audit/inspection mgmt., document and knowledge, change control, supplier management, and other priority execution workflows.

  • Partnering across sites and functions, process, and technology requirements inclusive of control requirements, workflow and business-rule requirements, escalation requirements, user needs, and business acceptance criteria that translate into measurable business outcomes.

  • Drive the evolution from process-centric Quality Management System (QMS) operations toward platform-enabled quality execution consistent with the future-state Quality Operating Model supporting the GxP continuum. This is inclusive of developing the organizational construct required to sustain this digital QMS evolution. Directionally role will oversee a group of 10 to 15 professional staff from Sr. Director to Specialist level as appropriate based on design of organization.

  • Establish platform operating disciplines for intake, prioritization, release governance, defect management, service health, and value realization.

  • Partner with R&D, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Enterprise Technology & Data Governance (ETDG), and external partners to ensure platform solutions meet business, compliance, and inspection-readiness expectations.

  • Lead adoption, process harmonization, and business readiness for deployed platforms, including role-based enablement and performance support.

  • Define platform health metrics, operational KPIs, and value measures tied to quality, compliance, speed, user experience, and ROI.

  • Ensure platforms are designed and operated in a manner that supports auditability, contemporaneous evidence, data integrity, and sustainable lifecycle management.

  • Serve as the senior quality business owner for platform priorities and represent the platform portfolio in executive governance and health authority discussions, as needed.

What this role owns:

  • Business ownership of GxP Quality Execution Platforms. This role may have operational execution of one or more of these workflows as well as the overall capabilities of QOSS evolves.

  • Digital Platform roadmaps and investment priorities for each workflow and business-rule implementation in the platforms

  • Platform operations, release governance, and service performance translated into significant Return on Investment and business outcomes

  • User adoption, process harmonization, and business readiness

  • Translation of governance and control requirements into platform design

Critical role interfaces:

  • The need to understand the overarching business strategy in R&D and Operations is paramount to working with and aligning with other critical programs and their interdependencies and needs for the QMS platform work and delivering in tandem to drive business results.

  • This role will have critical groups it engages with that together aim at delivering the integrated GxP QOM vision and strategy as follows:

  • Quality Risk & System Governance: receives control standards, escalation logic, governance requirements, and management review requirements partners to embed them into platform workflows and evidence outputs.

  • Digital Business Platform (Capability) Owner - primarily owns business outcomes of a digital capability - owns the end-to-end business digital capability, defining the vision, priorities, operating model, and value realization while driving the adoption.

  • Head of Technology (Client-Facing Technology - IT) - primarily owns Technology strategy & delivery - Owns the technology strategy, architecture, engineering, and lifecycle management required to deliver secure, scalable, and AI-ready digital capabilities that enable the business vision.

  • Lead, AI & Data Science (Business) - primarily owns AI & analytics strategy and expertise - Leads the AI, analytics, and data science capability by developing reusable models, insights, and AI solutions that accelerate business transformation and decision-making.

  • Validation & Digital Assurance: partners on CSA/CSV strategy, risk-based validation requirements, and inspection-ready lifecycle documentation while preserving independent assurance.

  • Global Quality Operations functions – these groups support the execution of our development pipeline, launch and in-line supply. The systems and processes enabled by this function are critical to enablement of the broader business strategy, on-going inspection readiness, and project imperatives.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

The executive candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of Quality, Operations, Product Development, Digital or related functions experience with demonstrated expertise in Digital Quality inclusive of AI-enablement OR

  • Master’s degree & 10 years of Quality, Operations, Product Development, Digital or related functions experience with demonstrated expertise in Digital Quality inclusive of AI-enablement OR

  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of Quality, Operations, Product Development, Digital or related functions experience with demonstrated expertise in Digital Quality inclusive of AI-enablement AND

  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of leadership experience managing leaders, matrix teams, complex programs, or enterprise transformations.

  • Demonstrated GxP quality expertise and practical understanding of end-to-end quality execution processes across development and/or commercial operations with strong proficiency in understanding GxP global regulations.

  • Experience leading or owning digital quality, workflow, or enterprise platform transformations including experience adopting and governing the operational use of AI-enabled quality solutions.

  • Deep understanding of GxP QMS / QMOS / QOM operating models and how to translate them into digital workflow platforms.

  • Experience as a senior business owner, product owner, or transformation leader for quality systems, content/document ecosystems, event management, or related platforms.

  • Strong understanding of inspection readiness optics, data integrity expectations, AI development and validation requirements and evidence-generation requirements in digital environments.

  • Experience managing global teams and multi-year platform portfolios with measurable value realization.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspiration: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection

  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders

  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being.

From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we will support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $263,692 - $322,290 Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.excerpt: Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations.
jobs.description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

Availity is seeking a visionary and execution-oriented Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer to help shape the company's future growth and competitive position within the evolving healthcare ecosystem. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, this leader will partner closely with the CEO, Board, and executive team to define Availity's long-term strategy, identify new growth opportunities, lead corporate development activities, and drive enterprise-wide strategic initiatives. The role is responsible for identifying growth vectors, assessing how Availity competes, and determining whether strategic priorities are best achieved through organic investment, partnerships, acquisitions, or new business ventures.

The ideal candidate brings a unique combination of strategic insight, business judgment, healthcare industry expertise, and transaction experience, with a demonstrated ability to translate strategy into measurable business outcomes.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Location: Remote, US

Why you want to work on this team:

  • Opportunity to serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board, and Executive Leadership Team.
  • Executive-level scope across enterprise strategy, corporate development, partnerships, innovation, and transformation.
  • Opportunity to build and lead strategic capabilities that will have a measurable impact on Availity’s future growth and competitive position.

To be qualified for this position you have:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategy, corporate development, investment banking, consulting, healthcare technology, or related fields.
  • Significant experience leading enterprise strategy initiatives and growth programs.
  • Experience evaluating and executing mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, investments, or divestitures.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and business modeling capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success influencing executive leaders and Boards.
  • Healthcare technology, healthcare services, payer, provider, revenue cycle, or interoperability experience.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced business degree.
  • Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives in high-growth or rapidly evolving organizations.
  • Enterprise thinking and long-term orientation.
  • Strategic curiosity and market awareness.
  • Strong business and financial acumen.
  • Executive influence and relationship building.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills.
  • Bias toward action and execution.
  • Ability to build alignment without direct authority.

You will set yourself apart with:

  • Ability to advise and influence CEOs, executive leadership teams, and Boards with credibility and clarity.
  • Innovation mindset with experience identifying growth opportunities tied to healthcare technology, AI, automation, interoperability, and administrative simplification.
  • Experience operating effectively in high-growth, fast-paced, or rapidly evolving organizations.

What you will be doing:

Enterprise Strategy

  • Leading the development and refinement of Availity's long-term strategic plan.
  • Partnering with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team to establish enterprise priorities and growth objectives.
  • Facilitating strategic planning, capital allocation, and portfolio management processes.
  • Developing frameworks that enable effective enterprise decision-making and prioritization.
  • Monitoring industry trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, and regulatory developments that affect Availity's business.

Corporate Development

  • Developing and executing Availity's corporate development strategy.
  • Identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing acquisition, investment, partnership, and joint venture opportunities.
  • Leading strategic due diligence efforts, valuation analyses, and transaction execution.
  • Presenting recommendations and investment theses to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Building and maintaining a robust pipeline of strategic growth opportunities.
  • Managing external advisors, investment bankers, consultants, and legal partners as required.

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Growth

  • Expanding Availity's influence and position across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Developing strategic relationships with payers, providers, technology partners, and emerging healthcare innovators.
  • Identifying opportunities to strengthen Availity's network advantage, interoperability capabilities, and market position.
  • Evaluating opportunities to accelerate growth through partnership models and strategic alliances.

Innovation & Future Growth

  • Identifying emerging opportunities in healthcare technology, AI, interoperability, automation, and administrative simplification.
  • Helping the organization balance investment in current operations with future growth opportunities.
  • Evaluating new markets, business models, product opportunities, and revenue streams.

Enterprise Transformation

  • Leading or sponsoring strategic initiatives that drive enterprise growth, operational effectiveness, and organizational alignment.
  • Ensuring strategic objectives are translated into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Monitoring strategic initiative performance and ensuring accountability for results.
  • Serving as a thought partner to leaders across Product, Technology, Growth, Operations, and Finance.

Board & Executive Leadership Support

  • Preparing strategic recommendations, market analyses, and investment proposals for Board review.
  • Serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.
  • Communicating Availity's strategic direction clearly and consistently across the organization.

Availity culture and benefits:

  • Availity is a certified “Great Place to Work”! Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!
  • We have several Culture teams, a Young Professionals Group, and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates – if you’re near Jacksonville, we have lots of pop up lunches where lunch is provided for everyone when we can see meetings are taking place and we’ve got teams in the office.
  • Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack and in our industry that can help get you there too!
  • Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.
  • We offer a competitive salary, bonus structure, generous HSA company contribution, healthcare, vision, dental benefits and a 401k match program that you can take advantage of on day one!
  • We offer unlimited PTO for salaried associates + 9 paid holidays. Hourly associates start at 19 days of PTO and go up from there with all the same holiday benefits.
  • Interested in wellness? We allow our associates to reimburse up to $250/year for gym memberships, participation in racing events, weight management programs, etc.
  • Interested in furthering your education? We offer education reimbursement!
  • Availity offers Paid Parental Leave for both moms and dads, both birth parents and adoptive parents.
  • Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with various organizations, both locally and nationally, to raise awareness, funds and morale as our staff members volunteer their time and funds to engage the organizations campaign.

Next steps:

After you apply, you will receive text/email messages thanking you for applying and then you will continue to receive more text/email messages alerting you as to where you are in the recruitment process.

Interview process:

  • Recruiter Recorded Video Pre-Screen
  • Panel Video Interview
  • Video Interviews with C-Suite Executives
  • Video Interview with CEO

Video Camera Usage:

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

Marketing & Communications Manager - FamilyWell Health & FamilyWell Academy

Location: Remote

Department: Marketing & Communications

Reports To: Head of Growth Operations

Job Type: Part-Time, Contract, up to 25–30 hours per week (with potential path to full-time)

Compensation: $55–$70/hr depending on experience

Scope: Supports both FamilyWell Health (clinical/B2B) and FamilyWell Academy (D2C/partnerships/education)

About FamilyWell Health

FamilyWell Health is an AI-enabled mental health startup dedicated to addressing the women's mental health crisis by seamlessly embedding high-quality, equitable, and affordable mental health care into women’s health practices and health systems. Our comprehensive virtual care model delivers evidence-based mental health services across the full reproductive lifecycle, from fertility through menopause, using the proven Collaborative Care Model (CoCM).

Our AI-enabled platform integrates coaching, therapy, psychiatry, and care coordination services directly into clinical workflows, making mental health care accessible, affordable, and insurance-covered. With 95% of patients experiencing clinical improvement within four months, FamilyWell is addressing one of healthcare's most underserved areas while building a financially sustainable model for provider partners.

Following our recent Series A raise, we are expanding nationally and seeking exceptional leaders to join our mission-driven team. Learn more at .

Role Summary

FamilyWell is looking for a hands-on Marketing & Communications Manager who can move fluidly between clinical credibility and consumer resonance. This is not a role for someone who delegates execution — you will write the copy, build the sequences, design the assets, and own the strategy behind all of it.

You will be the primary marketing voice for two distinct but connected brands: FamilyWell Health, our clinical care platform serving patients and health system partners, and FamilyWell Academy, our professional training and certification program for perinatal mental health providers. These audiences require different tones, channels, and funnels — and you will navigate both with intention.

You are proactive, not reactive. You look at what the data is telling you and adjust. You use AI as a productivity tool but you can immediately spot the difference between generated filler and writing that actually earns attention. You produce the latter.

What You Will Own

Content Strategy & Writing (25%)

  • Develop and execute a content strategy across both FamilyWell Health and FamilyWell Academy, with distinct voice and audience mapping for each
  • Write in a clinical, credible voice for provider-facing and health system content — white papers, one-pagers, case studies, and email campaigns
  • Write in an accessible, warm consumer voice for patient-facing and Academy learner content
  • Produce blog posts, newsletters, social copy, and nurture email sequences independently — not by prompting AI and publishing the output
  • Edit and elevate AI-assisted drafts with judgment about what reads as genuine versus generated

HubSpot & Nurture Marketing (25%)

  • Own HubSpot from strategy to execution: build and manage contact lists, segmentation, workflows, and email sequences
  • Design and deploy nurture campaigns for multiple audience segments — prospective clinical partners, Academy enrollees, and direct-to-consumer patient leads
  • Track open rates, click-through, conversion, and funnel movement; make data-informed adjustments to cadence, content, and segmentation
  • Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to ensure messaging accuracy and compliance with healthcare communication standards

Website & Digital Presence (15%)

  • Manage and update content on Squarespace for both brands, including landing pages, course pages, and campaign-specific pages
  • Ensure SEO fundamentals are applied across web content
  • Maintain a consistent visual and editorial brand across all digital touchpoints

Design & Asset Production (15%)

  • Produce branded visual assets in Canva: social graphics, email headers, event materials, one-pagers, and provider-facing educational content
  • Manage an organized asset library and maintain brand consistency across both FamilyWell entities
  • Support Academy course marketing materials and promotional collateral

Social Media Planning & Management (20%)

  • Develop a social media content calendar across LinkedIn and Instagram that serves both brands
  • Write and schedule posts; monitor engagement and community signals
  • Identify relevant cultural and clinical moments in maternal and perinatal mental health to build timely content around

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of marketing and communications experience, with demonstrated B2B and D2C work
  • Exceptional writing ability across multiple voices and formats — clinical, consumer, and editorial
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience: you have built workflows, sequences, and reports yourself, based on desired goals.
  • Experience managing or editing a website in Squarespace or a comparable CMS
  • Comfort with AI writing tools paired with strong editorial judgment — you know when to use them and when to rewrite
  • Ability to work independently, set priorities, and surface recommendations without being asked
  • Experience analyzing marketing data and translating it into strategic adjustments
  • Familiarity with healthcare, mental health, women's health, or a similarly regulated, relationship-driven sector

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in perinatal or maternal health, behavioral health, or clinical education marketing
  • Background supporting both a direct care brand and a professional education or certification product
  • Partnership or B2B outreach experience — writing for health systems, OB/GYN practices, or institutional buyers
  • Canva proficiency for production-ready asset creation
  • Comfort with social media strategy and scheduling tools

Who Thrives in This Role

You are someone who reads about perinatal mental health on your own time. You care about the mission and it shows in your copy. You can sit in a strategy meeting and a Canva file in the same afternoon. You do not wait to be told what to post or what to send — you come with a plan and can explain what problem it is solving. You hold a high personal standard for what you'll put FamilyWell's name on, including in AI output. You communicate proactively when something is off track and bring solutions, not just flags.

Please be aware of recruitment scams. FamilyWell will never ask candidates to pay money, request sensitive personal information early in the process, or conduct interviews over unsecured platforms. All official communication will come from an @ email address.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

eQuip is hiring a Director of Platform & Agent Operations to own the autonomous and AI-augmented systems that increasingly run the work of all team members. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who builds, directs, and operates AI rather than merely supervising people who do. The successful candidate will be measured on the work their AI systems complete - not on credentials, pedigree, or years served.

Job Description:

Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, the Director of Platform & Agent Operations leads the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of the platforms and autonomous agents that perform real work across eQuip - from engineering and delivery to customer support and internal operations. You will spend your days directing AI to do work, diagnosing and fixing AI processes when they drift or fail, and engineering systems in which AI agents complete multi-step work with little or no human input.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Autonomous System Design: Architect, build, and operate AI agents and multi-agent workflows that complete real work - code, documentation, data analysis, ticket triage, customer responses - with limited or no human direction. Move systems progressively up the autonomy ladder from assisted to supervised to fully autonomous.

  • Directing AI: Act as the primary operator who tasks, steers, and supervises AI assistants and agents day to day. Decompose ambiguous business goals into instructions, context, and tool definitions that AI can reliably execute.

  • Fixing AI Processes: Diagnose and remediate failing or drifting AI workflows - hallucination, tool-use errors, context loss, runaway cost, unsafe output. Own the on-call posture for agent systems the way a platform team owns production services.

  • Context Engineering: Design and maintain the context systems - instructions, retrieved knowledge, memory, tool schemas, and guardrails - that give agents domain expertise and keep them reliable and safe in production.

  • Evaluation & Observability: Build the eval harnesses, metrics, and monitoring that prove an agent works before it ships and catch regressions after. Define what “good” looks like for each workflow and instrument it.

  • Platform Ownership: Own the underlying platform - model access, orchestration frameworks, MCP integrations, deployment pipelines, and cost controls - that agent systems run on. Integrate with existing tooling (Monday.com, HubSpot, GitHub, Azure).

  • Tooling & Integration: Connect agents to the systems where work actually happens via APIs, Model Context Protocol servers, and custom tools, so that autonomous work flows into real business outcomes.

  • Governance & Safety: Implement and enforce AI acceptable-use, security, and compliance controls (including CUI/CMMC-aligned practices) across all agent and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Enablement & Mentorship: Raise the AI fluency of all team members - sharing patterns for prompting, context engineering, agent design, and eval literacy so teams can safely operate their own AI.

  • Offshore Team Enablement: Train and support eQuip's offshore team, who will serve as operators of our AI systems. Teach them how to use the different AI tools, agents, and processes that power their work, and build the documentation, runbooks, and guardrails that let them operate those systems reliably and safely.

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Partner with Engineering, Customer Support, and portfolio leadership to identify the highest-leverage processes to automate and to measure the business impact of the systems you deploy.

Preferred skills:

  • Experience building production agent systems with the Anthropic SDK, OpenAI Agents, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.

  • Experience standing up Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrating agents with business systems (examples: Monday.com, HubSpot, GitHub, Azure DevOps).

  • Background in full-stack or platform engineering, MLOps, or production observability for AI systems.

  • AI cost optimization, guardrail/safety design, and computer-use or browser-automation deployment.

  • Experience in regulated or defense environments, including CUI handling and CMMC-aligned practices.

  • Prior experience leading or mentoring a team, or building enablement programs for AI adoption.

  • Relevant agentic AI certifications (a plus, not a requirement)

Regular

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Workforce Architect to partner with business units in shaping a forward-looking talent agenda that enables performance today and positions the business for the future, with scope scaled to defined business areas. This role works with business leaders to develop actionable strategies for how work gets done, how talent is deployed, and how workforce choices support performance, productivity, and risk management. The Workforce Architect brings strong analytical rigor and a developing strategic perspective—leading core analyses while contributing to framing decisions and trade-offs. This role is both hands-on and consultative: responsible for building models, scenarios, and materials that inform decisions, while working with leaders to translate insights into action. Success depends on the ability to get into the details (data, assumptions, drivers, and implications), synthesize findings into clear recommendations, and build credibility through well-structured, data-driven insights.

Essential Job Functions

  • Partner with business leaders to develop and shape workforce and talent strategy aligned to business priorities and performance goals.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of the workforce for assigned areas, identifying emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Analyze workforce structure, capacity, and skills, identifying opportunities to improve performance and efficiency.
  • Build scenario models to explore workforce options and support decision-making across near- and mid-term horizons.
  • Translate enterprise workforce frameworks into practical applications tailored to business context.
  • Surface insights from workforce data and diagnostics, converting complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Advise leaders on workforce implications of hiring decisions, restructuring, and capability requirements.
  • Partner with Finance, Workforce Analytics, Talent Acquisition, and Compensation to ensure alignment of data, assumptions, and decisions.
  • Promote consistent and disciplined use of workforce tools and approaches.
  • Develop clear materials that frame workforce insights in a way that supports leader decision-making.

Requirements

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree required.

Experience Requirements

2-3 years of experience solving complex business problems and driving strategy-to-execution in roles such as product, operations, business line leadership (e.g., business insurance), marketing, management consulting, strategy, or FP&A within complex organizations.

Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on workforce or operating-model decisions.

Special Skill Requirements / Additional Qualifications

  • Strong analytical capability, including workforce analytics, forecasting, scenario modeling, and interpretation of external labor market trends.
  • Ability to influence without authority, building credibility and alignment across functions and business units leveraging empirical and qualitative data and expertise-based perspective.
  • Clear, concise communicator with strong storytelling skills; experience developing materials for senior leadership.
  • Experience modernizing or improving workforce or planning approaches using data, automation, or contemporary tools.
  • Solid business and financial acumen, with an understanding of workforce economics, productivity drivers, and cost trade-offs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, while forcing clarity to advise leaders in navigating complex, future-oriented decisions.
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity and emotional intelligence.
  • Experience with Excel, Power BI, and Workday is a plus.
  • Experience with org design, capacity planning, and strategic workforce planning is a plus.
